purpose: Form CAA-10A is used to file an auditor certificate confirming that certain unlisted companies meeting loan, debenture, and deposit limits fulfill the required conditions for a merger or amalgamation scheme under section 233 of the Act.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Verify that the scheme is between eligible classes of companies under Rule 25.
Ensure the company has an auditor certificate confirming the required conditions are met.
File the approved scheme of merger or amalgamation under sub-section (2) of section 233.
File Form No. CAA-10A along with the copy of the approved scheme.
checklist: Auditor certificate confirming the company meets the conditions for loans, debentures, and deposits.
Copy of the approved scheme referred to in sub-section (2) of section 233 of the Act.
